title: Net Worth Calculator
description: Add up everything you own and owe to get your net worth, with a full assets-vs-liabilities breakdown.
howto: Enter the value of each asset you own.
Read your net worth and the full breakdown.

faqs.a: Cash, savings, investments, retirement accounts, home equity (use market value), vehicles and other valuables.

faqs.q: Should I use market value or what I paid?
faqs.a: Current market value — what you could sell it for today. That is what net worth measures.
Yes, and it is common early in a career (student loans, car loans). The trend over time matters more than one number.
